summary: Resource monitors (MonitorType CPU, Memory or Disk; SamplingInterval; AlertRules; Path for disk) raise alerts that set device status to degraded or error; each alert rule has Severity (Info, Warning, Critical, one per level), Duration (averaging window), Percentage threshold and Description.
